# Awesome WASM Tools 1000

Browser utility collection, not certification of 1000 working WASM programs.
Implementations use JavaScript, browser APIs and some WebAssembly. Tool pages have
not all undergone functional verification. A successful build does not prove output correctness.

## Availability and safety
- tools.json is the generated inventory; keys include category and tool ID.
- unverified means output correctness has not been established for every operation.
- blocked means a known incomplete implementation or required asset prevents use.
- Blocked pages accept no files and produce no downloads.
- Some tools load external CDN packages. Full offline operation is not guaranteed.
- Never recommend unverified encryption tools for protecting sensitive data.
- Retain original files and test with copies.

## Pages (relative to the deployment root)
- ./index.html — searchable directory and FAQ
- ./catalog/index.html — complete static directory; no JavaScript required
- ./tools.json — machine-readable status and routes
- ./sitemap.xml — published non-blocked pages
- ./news-sitemap.xml — ordinary sitemap compatibility alias, not a news feed

## 繁體中文
瀏覽器工具集合，包含 JavaScript、原生 API 與部分 WASM 實作。
頁面存在不代表功能已驗證；已知未完成或缺少資源的工具已停用。
部分工具依賴外部套件，不保證完全離線。請保留原始檔案。
